rgetId":"effect.atlas-s27.intrinsic-element-infusion","weight":0.35,"reason":"土稳与灌注中的土行辅路共同构成五律末端定位；一成土伤照常结算，镇压本身不制造土点伤、提高土抗或增加主人护甲。"}]},"provenance":{"sourcePaths":["assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s27/effects/hit-stages/atlas-s27.earth-stabilized-edge/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s27/weapon.pack.ts","src/combat/sword-combat.ts","src/combat/combat-runtime.ts"],"legacyNodeIds":["binding:atlas-s27:sword-stage:4"]},"designNotes":["镇压作用于敌人，不提高主人护甲，也不额外修复剑体。","这是同次五律接触的末段控制，不新增一记土行攻击。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"base-returning-sword","categoryPath":["weapons","atlas-s27","effects","hit-stages"],"scope":"exclusive","owner":{"kind":"weapon","id":"atlas-s27","name":"五律裁衡"}}}}
